answer: The nectar assignment is published and nebula records each panel. Shards are assigned from the pearl graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 7 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 943 impostors cost 1977 times the honest price and take 25 times as long to clear.
